SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH: The even was successful and graded over 60 projects

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC: Became the Circuits 1 Lab Chair. Organized multiple meetings during the semester and spear headed changes to the Labs.
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH:
Standardized the topics to be cover in the Circuits 1 Lab.
Standardized the order of the topics to be covered.
Finalized the changes to be made to the labs.

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC: I attended the Extreme Computing event in Edinburg and Brownsville, as Supervisor required by IEEE.
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH: The event was Successful and the students were able to participate in the coding competition

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC: Attended the IT Industry Sector Partnership Forum. It was very interesting and they covered multiple projects currently focused on improving the RGV.
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH: There were 4 speakers and covered multiple IT projects that will benefit the RGV
